speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Amoxicillin-induced morbilliform drug eruption with associated arthralgia.

The clinical picture of a pruritic, blanching maculopapular rash appearing 4-7 days after starting amoxicillin, accompanied by low-grade fever and symmetric joint pain, is classic for a delayed hypersensitivity reaction. The negative history of respiratory symptoms helps rule out Stevens-Johnson Syndrome or DRESS syndrome. I will now confirm the diagnosis and advise on management.
